specs.brief: Five school magnets in one evenly spaced specimen row: rectangular red-blue bar; red-blue U shape; black ferrite ring with hole; solid flat grey disc; solid taller grey cylinder. Each fully visible, no labels.

Overhead foreground study of a red-left N / blue-right S bar magnet on a small sheet of paper. Tiny graphite iron filings form dense irregular textured clusters around both end poles, sparse in middle and gently curving outside the bar. Physical grains, no decorative drawn field lines.

Three bar magnets on one baseline. Left one whole long bar red-left N blue-right S. Right two short separate bars each half its length, with a clear gap between them. EACH short bar is red-left N blue-right S, to show each piece has both poles. No shards, no tools.

Two foreground objects side by side: on left overhead brass-rimmed simple compass, ivory face with N top E right S bottom W left. Red needle exactly points up to N and blue tail down to S. On right a larger side elevation of one red-blue needle balanced horizontally with exact middle touching the tip of a small brass pivot below. No other markings.

Accurate right hand holding a small red-blue bar magnet with BLUE end touching a horizontal steel sewing needle near left end. Whole needle visible, eye left point right. It is a one-direction stroking demonstration. No arrows or text. Foreground objects only, no desk or backdrop.

Two distinct groups across a wide horizontal row. Left group: horizontal bar red-left N blue-right S resting on two ROUND wooden pencil rollers oriented front-back; another identical bar just right with small gap so S faces N. Right group: bar red-left N blue-right S on round pencil rollers; second bar just right flipped blue-left S red-right N so S faces S. Red always N blue always S. Exact clear labels on bar ends. No arrows no heading.

Two comparison groups across wide row, each a horizontal red-blue bar magnet to LEFT of a simple round compass. Left group: bar blue-left S red-right N; the compass red needle tip points RIGHT, away from nearby N. Right group: bar red-left N blue-right S; compass red needle tip points LEFT toward S. Blue needle tail opposite red. Compass faces blank without direction letters. No arrows or headings.

Elevated oblique view of exactly three objects on common ground: a red-left N blue-right S bar magnet at left; a thin rectangular wooden sheet standing vertically edge-on in central gap; small round compass flat at right. Compass red needle points LEFT toward blue S through the wood. No cardinal letters on compass, no glow or force lines.

Two identical dark grey ferrite ring magnets threaded on a vertical slim wood rod mounted on rectangular wood base. Rod visibly passes through both holes. Lower ring sits at base; upper ring hovers well above it with large empty air gap. Identical diameter horizontal rings with holes obvious in three-quarter view. No labels.

Shallow brass dish with pale gold oil, viewed obliquely. Fish-shaped grey iron vane sits on a thin small cork float on the liquid. Whole simple model visible. No antique decorative ornament and no labels.

Four distinct foreground vignettes in 2x2 grid with large transparent gutters. Top left red-blue magnet with steel clip chain hanging from and touching blue end. Top right cardboard maze on four blocks, steel ball on top, hand holding bar magnet directly beneath board visible through open front. Bottom left clear glass with steel clip against inner side, magnet at same point outside glass. Bottom right two plain wood toy cars each with four wheels and bar magnet fixed on top; facing ends both blue. No labels, no borders.
Keep the whole ship and a narrow cluster of waves at its hull. Remove the sky, storm clouds and all broad background washes. Foreground-focused sailing ship cutout, deck and masts preserved.
Preserve complete stand including base, thread tied to midpoint of level bar magnet. Remove white background and tabletop wash.
Preserve bowl, water, cork and taped steel needle exactly. Remove white background outside bowl, keep glass edges.
Preserve the two magnets, opposite pole colours, wood spacer and both steel keepers. Remove entire white background.

Keep accurate hand holding magnet above paper butterfly and steel clip, visible gap, taut thread down to tape on small patch of wood. Remove all broad white background and most tabletop except a small support patch around taped thread.
